error[ZBX-E0905]: no trusted signature covers what was to run
  while  checking b3:0123456789abcdef against the policy
         /home/alice/.config/zbx/policy.zon
  cause  /home/alice/.config/zbx/policy.zon requires a signature
         (require_signature), and nothing has signed b3:0123456789abcdef
  digest b3:0123456789abcdef
  policy /home/alice/.config/zbx/policy.zon
  fix    sign it with a key the policy lists:   zbx sign b3:0123456789abcdef
         or add the signer's key to the policy file
  more   zbx explain E0905
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0905.html
